title: Phase gate: full CI, lighting and animation tours, docs, push
player_outcome: All P1 fixes arrive together, verified in the engine on every graphics preset and pushed to the branch.
design: Run the complete CI sequence locally: check_file_length, dotnet build and test, gen_ore_tiers --check, manifest --check, validate, gen_reference --check, build_all.py --check, coverage, every game/Testing/Scripts/*.cmds headless (all print SMOKE PASS), and --menu-tour (MENU PASS).
Run lavapipe lighting.cmds (all presets) and animation.cmds on medium. Record the shot_stats.py numbers in the commit message or PR body next to the pre-P1 baseline.
Update docs/3D_TERRARIA_MASTER_PLAN.md status rows touched by P1 (hooks, lighting, animation, crosshair names) and confirm the rendering.md and gameplay.md edits from each package are consistent.
Commit per package (already done) and push to claude/clever-goodall-kgex45.
tests: Every smoke script, including the new lines in basic/combat/movement/town.cmds, and the menu tour
verification: All CI steps green locally with dotnet-sdk-8.0 and Godot 4.7.2 mono headless
lavapipe tour screenshots inspected: desert and tundra not blown out on medium/high/ultra; torch corridor lit to about 10 m; swing, mine and bow poses correct
PerfOverlay spot-check on low and ultra: no new frame-time spikes (gd.interaction.physics, gd.dynamic_lights, gd.view_model, gd.grapple all < 0.2 ms)
risks: lavapipe tours are slow; run the lighting and animation tours only, not the full screenshot tour.
